_doc: capA assertion 4 — WHO PASSES each authority site, resolved against the three default bundles.
Keyed on file::binding, NEVER file:line — a binding name survives an edit above it (tech-debt #78).
A change to any `roles` array FAILS the build. To accept one: re-run with --baseline AND write
a `why`. An empty `roles` (the site admits NOBODY) requires a `why` even on first sight.

packages/cultivar-os/src/pages/CustomerC.why: SEED DECLARATION (David, 2026-07-31, ledger #173). Was deliveries:create — a string the MANAGER does not hold, and wrong on the merits: this field writes orders.delivery_date, a COLUMN ON `orders`; it never touches the `deliveries` table. Now orders:create, per the ruling A PERMISSION GATES A CAPABILITY, NOT A FIELD. STAFF is admitted DELIBERATELY: they hold orders:create and take orders, so they set the date on the order they are taking. orders:update would have handed the field to the manager and withheld it from the person standing in the lot.

packages/cultivar-os/src/pages/Dashboard.why: FIXED 2026-07-31 (David's ruling, ledger #174): `view_costs` → `costs:read`. Was a LEGACY string admitting NOBODY INCLUDING THE OWNER — the inventory-value metric was dark for everyone and :160 did not request `unit_cost`. The metric is qty × unit_cost, the cost basis and nothing else, so of `view_costs`' eight successors only `costs:read` describes what is read. OWNER-only is correct: cost is confidential (§4), and the same string already gates /costs, /inventory and PMI.

packages/cultivar-os/src/pages/DeliveryS.why: SEED DECLARATION (David, 2026-07-31, ledger #173). WIDENED to MANAGER by the Phase 2 conversion (isOwner && ... -> can('customers:update')). CORRECT: the manager holds customers:update by bundle and this affordance edits a customer from the delivery row — the door now matches the vault. It is declared rather than assumed because nobody reports a widening; the person who gained the button does not file a ticket.

packages/cultivar-os/src/pages/Inventory.why: FIXED 2026-07-31 (David's ruling, ledger #174): `import_pricing` → `inventory:import_price`, a pure 1:1 rename with no judgement in it. Was a LEGACY string admitting NOBODY, so the owner was told his own prices would not save. OWNER-only matches the bundle: `inventory:import_price` is a BLAST-RADIUS authority (bulk CSV price write) held by the owner alone, and the server's import_write_price RPC is the real gate — this flag is the courtesy marker in front of it.

packages/cultivar-os/src/pages/OrderDeta.why: SEED DECLARATION (David, 2026-07-31, ledger #173). One legacy string, TWO verbs: `manage_orders` became orders:update HERE and orders:create at ScanOrder::canInvoke. Both are defensible per site — editing an existing order is not the same act as taking a new one — and the split was invisible as a SET until this baseline listed them side by side. That visibility is the deliverable.

packages/cultivar-os/src/pages/ScanOrder.why: SEED DECLARATION (David, 2026-07-31, ledger #173). WIDENED to STAFF by the Phase 2 conversion (isOwner || can('manage_orders') -> can('orders:create')), and CORRECT per David's 2026-07-27 fulfilment ruling: a staff member reads what the work requires and takes the order. Recorded here because it was right BY ACCIDENT of the string chosen, not by a decision anybody wrote down — 'probably right and undeclared' is the state this assertion exists to end.

packages/cultivar-os/src/pages/SettingsI.why: SEED DECLARATION (David, 2026-07-31, ledger #173). One legacy string, THREE verbs: `manage_settings` became settings:read HERE, settings:update at Dashboard::canManageSettings and Settings::canManageSettings, and team:read at MemberConsole. Note the binding NAME is identical at three sites while the string is not — read the strings, never the name. Defensible per site; recorded as a set.

a7Declared.view_dashboard: AWAITING RULING #87 — navPermission()'s fallback (tileRegistry.ts:432-433). R3 retired the string into the `member` sentinel. UNREACHABLE TODAY: 0 of 26 nav nodes hit it, because every node declares a tileKey or its own permission. A landmine, not a live defect — the next node added without either goes invisible to EVERYONE including the owner. Fallback to `member`, or delete the fallback and make the field required? David rules.
a7Declared.reports:read: AWAITING RULING #88 — the `business_insights` tile (tileRegistry.ts:204). The string is in NO manifest, current or legacy. The tile is status:'planned', nav_eligible:false, so nothing is broken today; it ships invisible on the day it is built, and that will read as a build bug rather than a permission one. Mint `reports:read` in the model, or point the tile at an existing string? David rules.
